description: Change the gap between items as the Gap tool does: resize the gap (the facing edges move apart or together and the items resize), move the gap (both facing edges move the same way), or move the items on one side so the gap is a set size

after.description: Items on the right of the gap (side_by_side) or below it (stacked)

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

arrangement.description: side_by_side: the gap runs up and down between items left and right of it; stacked: it runs across between items above and below

before.description: Items on the left of the gap (side_by_side) or above it (stacked)

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

by.description: move_gap: how far to move the gap (mm; right or down is positive)

mode.description: resize_gap: make the gap `size` wide by moving both facing edges (items resize); move_gap: shift the gap `by` mm (items on both sides resize); move_items: move the after items so the gap is `size`

name: adjust_gap
title: Adjust Gap
